attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Core change to shape table caching/locking mechanism (used on every request across all tenants/themes) replaces a semaphore with ILocalLock and Task-based cache entries, requiring an added DI registration for ILocalLock in every host — a missing registration or subtle deadlock/race in the new lock-then-check pattern could break rendering tenant-wide, though the change is well-tested and logically sound."}
